summary: Aurora Cannabis filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its unaudited interim condensed consolidated financial statements and interim MD&A for the three and six months ended September 30, 2026, together with CEO and CFO certifications, all incorporated by reference into its Form F-10 and S-8 registration statements. The filing is an ordinary periodic reporting package for a foreign private issuer, with no transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics disclosed. No special-situation catalyst is present; the operative items are quarterly results, including net revenue of C$86.0 million, and Note 15's subsequent event, which warrants review as a routine disclosure rather than an event filing.
